notes.subject: ויהי
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'and it came to pass that Daniel was' — rendered as 'remained/continued', following the idiom rather than the literal 'was'

notes.subject: اُوتھے رہا
notes.rationale: 'continued/remained' supplied — Hebrew says only 'Daniel was until', the verb's continuation sense is inferred

notes.subject: پہلے ورھے تک
notes.rationale: A dated endpoint — Daniel's lifespan measured against the first year of Cyrus the king

translation: تے دانیایل اُوتھے رہا، کورِش بادشاہ دے پہلے ورھے تک۔
